title: 2 Chronicles 15: The Covenant to Seek the Most High
body:
Read the chapter → [2 Chronicles 15](/bible/2-chronicles/15)

**[2 Chronicles 15:1-7](/bible/2-chronicles/15#v1)**
> <sup>[1](/bible/2-chronicles/15#v1)</sup> And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded:
>
> <sup>[2](/bible/2-chronicles/15#v2)</sup> And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The Lord is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.
>
> <sup>[3](/bible/2-chronicles/15#v3)</sup> Now for a long season Israel hath been without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law.
>
> <sup>[4](/bible/2-chronicles/15#v4)</sup> But when they in their trouble did turn unto the Lord God of Israel, and sought him, he was found of them.
>
> <sup>[5](/bible/2-chronicles/15#v5)</sup> And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries.
>
> <sup>[6](/bible/2-chronicles/15#v6)</sup> And nation was destroyed of nation, and city of city: for God did vex them with all adversity.
>
> <sup>[7](/bible/2-chronicles/15#v7)</sup> Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.

- The Spirit of God comes on Azariah the son of Oded, who meets Asa and says the Most High is with them while they are with him; if they seek him he will be found, but if they forsake him he will forsake them.
- Israel had long been without the true God, a teaching priest, and law, but when in their trouble they turned to the Most High, he was found of them. Azariah charges Asa to be strong, for his work shall be rewarded.

**[2 Chronicles 15:8](/bible/2-chronicles/15#v8)**
> <sup>[8](/bible/2-chronicles/15#v8)</sup> And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim, and renewed the altar of the Lord, that was before the porch of the Lord.

- When Asa hears these words and the prophecy of Oded, he takes courage, puts away the abominable idols out of Judah, Benjamin, and the cities he took from mount Ephraim, and renews the altar of the Most High.
- Hearing the word gives courage still, for we teach our people who they are, that the Israelites and the Christ are black. Faith comes by hearing.
  - **[Romans 10:17](/bible/romans/10#v17)**
    > <sup>[17](/bible/romans/10#v17)</sup> So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

    So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

**[2 Chronicles 15:9-15](/bible/2-chronicles/15#v9)**
> <sup>[9](/bible/2-chronicles/15#v9)</sup> And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance, when they saw that the Lord his God was with him.
>
> <sup>[10](/bible/2-chronicles/15#v10)</sup> So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.
>
> <sup>[11](/bible/2-chronicles/15#v11)</sup> And they offered unto the Lord the same time, of the spoil which they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.
>
> <sup>[12](/bible/2-chronicles/15#v12)</sup> And they entered into a covenant to seek the Lord God of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul;
>
> <sup>[13](/bible/2-chronicles/15#v13)</sup> That whosoever would not seek the Lord God of Israel should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
>
> <sup>[14](/bible/2-chronicles/15#v14)</sup> And they sware unto the Lord with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.
>
> <sup>[15](/bible/2-chronicles/15#v15)</sup> And all Judah rejoiced at the oath: for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and the Lord gave them rest round about.

- Asa gathers Judah, Benjamin, and the strangers out of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon, who fell to him in abundance when they saw the Most High was with him. These strangers are Israelites whose hearts turned back.
- In the fifteenth year of Asa they enter a covenant to seek the Most High with all their heart and soul, that whosoever would not seek him should be put to death. They swear with a loud voice, and the Most High gives them rest round about.

**[2 Chronicles 15:16-19](/bible/2-chronicles/15#v16)**
> <sup>[16](/bible/2-chronicles/15#v16)</sup> And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king, he removed her from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove: and Asa cut down her idol, and stamped it, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.
>
> <sup>[17](/bible/2-chronicles/15#v17)</sup> But the high places were not taken away out of Israel: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
>
> <sup>[18](/bible/2-chronicles/15#v18)</sup> And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.
>
> <sup>[19](/bible/2-chronicles/15#v19)</sup> And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.

- Asa removes Maachah his mother from being queen because she made an idol in a grove; he cuts it down, stamps it, and burns it at the brook Kidron.
- Though the high places are not all taken away, the heart of Asa is perfect all his days. He brings the dedicated silver, gold, and vessels into the house of God, and there is no more war until the thirty and fifth year of his reign.
